readback.body:
Native issue93 preregistration, before any native trial invocation.

Producers: accepted95 production plus the identical shared observer at baseline [7341f20d](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/7341f20d874bd3dc5c6b2158bbea23fcbc4a810f), versus candidate [b7286805](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/b72868050aae51cd4e2e3e0615259ed790db7798). The baseline snapshot changes only the timestamp observation and generated exact test label; its production/math/selectors are95. Complete shared default/wide observer source is byte-identical between producers. Official exports: [baseline38094314945](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/38094314945) and [candidate38094316792](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/38094316792). Launch remains conditional on successful official exports/reconstruction,20 canonical/consumed input checks per producer,120 baseline and126 candidate whole readonly PE payload joins, and fresh whole source/product/provider/controller seals. All original40 arrays must remain exact; candidate adds only Dense/DP FMA. Independent source and apparatus reviews clear these obligations; no native result is established.

Actual provider must be Radeon780M / AMD26.8.1 LLPC. Native selected modules must keep CameraFp64, TransportFma, EndpointFma, InitializeFp64 and RayCameraFp64 exact, with precisely DenseFp64→DenseFma and DopriPhaseFp64→DopriPhaseFma. Required native wide arithmetic/FMA controls stay original. The complete seven selected module spans must match their actual bound arrays; DP loading alone is insufficient. Original capacity24, allocation cap8MiB, modern12 rays/projection budget24, all original numerical/assertion/refusal/recovery/rollback/row-position and dispatch criteria remain unchanged.

Run once, serially, stop at first failure: the original two Dense scientific/authority bodies and all five original DP bodies, then the additive shared wide complete-workload observer:

- `RetainedComputeTest.DenseSegmentsPreserveSmallCovariantArrivalDerivatives`
- `RetainedComputeTest.ZeroFractionArrivalsPreserveProgramAuthorityAndCompleteRefusal`
- `RetainedDopriTest.IndependentQuarticPreservesCompletePhase`
- `RetainedDopriTest.MalformedRowsRefuseAndRecover`
- `RetainedDopriTest.CurvedTransportConnectsSamplerAndProjection`
- `RetainedDopriTest.ConnectedIntervalsPreserveTrialsAndIndependentBudgets`
- `RetainedDopriTest.SamplerPreservesPhysicalArrivalAndRejectsInconsistentRates`
- `RetainedComputeTest.WideDeviceTimestampsPreserveOriginalIntervalResults`

If all8 controls and their terminal/source/provider checks pass, run exactly A1/B1/B2/A2 of the wide timestamp case, A=baseline and B=candidate, with no rerun or added favorable samples. Each process retains the original three legacy complete interval repeats (Dense executes) and three modern complete construction+interior-sampling repeats (DP executes),51 available ordered markers,32 full active raw readback records, original capsule/semantic/submission checks and entire4279/4149-word Dense/DP frames including reserved suffixes. All same-provider raw hashes and five unchanged selected modules must agree before considering speed; the two exact intentional transitions are required.

Statistic and adoption: forward A1/B1 and reverse A2/B2 are assessed separately. For each legacy/modern family, compare medians of the three complete-call repeats and require candidate improvement>=5% in each of all4 whole-path gates. For every labeled stage, sum inclusive Dispatch total_ms within each repeat, then compare medians of those three stage sums; regression must be<=5% in each direction (16 stage gates;20 total gates). Do not pool directions, compare sums of all repeats or accept isolated shader gains. Complete spans include original allocation/packing/decoding/marker/readback-copy observers and exclude assertions/digest serialization/result disposal; modern cost is attempt+sample. These are finite generally warm calls; startup/warm baseline/pipeline state is not a cold-driver assertion. Retention requires every gate and every original correctness/word/owner prerequisite.

Each Windows test owner has the declared300s/4GiB diagnostic guard, with a480s outer Linux bridge including bootstrap/preflight/terminal overhead; a stop is incomplete, never a pass. Held native handles, early exact births, bounded emergency cleanup and terminal provider/source rechecks remain mandatory. Terminal census claims only recorded births and accessible task-bound consumers, preserving hidden-field/handle/descendant visibility limits. Windows-owner, Linux-bridge and in-process call clocks retain their separate meanings.

Comparator SHA256 `c8990da2dc6994adeda2f98bad377d1ec44415995eaafcbc5926016fe4e3e56e`; reader SHA256 `46eac9e6d496e778494d6f4e7fa9d41cb5f74642acd4c4e33d31e26d501ec219`; plan SHA256 `f63aa31b7d168202b7567568eec6006ccecb362e656566047e85f4e4e10feb2d`. Freeze their exact bytes and full GitHub readback into the execution manifest before invocation. Rejection preserves raw failures and restores original selectors. No unchanged failed frame is rerun before accepted material benefit; this finite trial cannot close #44/#48/#53 or admit main/full science/runtime/platform/viewer/release qualification.
